name: Dougherty County, GA
findings: Dougherty County has 348 nonprofit organizations. 121 of them (35%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 95 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (30% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Dougherty County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Dougherty County list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 83 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
